stem: If $X={=setof(X)}$, $Y={=setof(Y)}$, and R is a relation from X to Y where $a\,R\,b$ means «$b = a + {=k}$», for each $a \in X$, $b \in Y$. Write R as a set of ordered pairs. (You would then show it in an arrow diagram and a cartesian diagram.)
solution: Each value of b is in Y, so $R=${=setof([pair(X[0], imgs[0]), pair(X[1], imgs[1]), pair(X[2], imgs[2])])}
notes: Basic: simple additive rule, every image lies in Y. Based on the book example's method (substitute each a, form (a, b)).
